CustomField.description: Join-barrier counter for parallel scoring batch shards (>50-article path). Seeded by KBAssessmentService.dispatchBatch with the number of concurrent KBAssessmentBatch shards; each shard's finish() decrements it under FOR UPDATE. The shard that decrements it to 0 is last-done and dispatches pipeline finalization. Null/0 means the single-batch (legacy) path, where finish() dispatches finalization directly.
CustomField.label: Scoring Shards Outstanding
